children: NTPC Limited (NSE:NTPC) is accelerating a Rs 17 lakh crore, decade‑long expansion—targeting 149 GW by 2032 and 30 GW nuclear by 2047—while building hydrogen, nuclear (6×1,000 MW VVER) and storage projects, seeking partners and international ties to meet rising El Niño, AI and industrial demand.
Previous Week Recap
NTPC Plans Rs 17 Lakh Crore Investment
: NTPC plans Rs 17 lakh crore investment over 10 years across thermal, gas, nuclear and storage; about Rs 7 lakh crore slated for deployment in the next five years.
NTPC 30 GW Nuclear By 2047
: NTPC plans 30 GW nuclear capacity by 2047, submitted three sites for clearance to India’s atomic regulators. Target and formal site filings reiterated.
NTPC Operational 91 GW, 149 GW Target
: NTPC reports 91 GW operational capacity, 35–37 GW under construction (≈17 GW coal) and targets 149 GW total capacity by 2032.
NTPC Hydrogen Hub At Simhadri
: NTPC is building a hydrogen hub at Simhadri to make green methanol and ammonia, plus a 20 km pipeline to link hydrogen supply with overseas buyers.
NTPC Six 1,000 MW VVER Reactors
: NTPC plans six 1,000 MW VVER reactors with Rosatom (6 GW). Seeking govt allocation under G2G; estimated cost ~Rs 1.5 trillion. NPCIL to continue Kudankulam work under 2014 India–Russia pact.
NTPC Chief: Demand Driven By El Niño
: NTPC Chairman Gurdeep Singh says elevated power demand stems from El Niño, economic growth and rising AI/data center needs; cooling load likely to become a major future demand driver.
NTPC Seeks Co‑Generation Partners
: NTPC seeks partners for 26% stakes in co‑generation projects combining coal, renewables and battery storage to supply steam and power under long‑term contracts to industrial consumers.
NTPC Africa50 Power Projects Exploration
: NTPC partners with Africa50 to identify and develop power projects and explore cross-border electricity trading in Africa, targeting generation assets and regional power-trade opportunities.
NTPC EDF MoU On Nuclear Tech
: NTPC signed an MoU with EDF in April to collaborate on nuclear power technology, part of NTPC’s broader international partnerships to advance its nuclear program.
NTPC To Supply Eskom Parts
: NTPC to supply components and spare parts to Eskom and use its maintenance services to help keep Eskom’s aging thermal plants running.
